scenes.objective: Compare a nearby covered teammate with another support option.
scenes.briefing: YOU have the puck. Navy2 is nearby, but Gold1 occupies the direct line to Navy2. Navy3 is farther away at another angle; Gold2 is away from that illustrated line.
